document.about: The Artificial Intelligence Act, (EU) 2024/1689, as the Publications Office serves it in XHTML: 13 chapters with sections and 113 articles, then 13 annexes, two of them with sections of their own; no h1 to h6 anywhere.

notes: The Official Journal's XHTML declares no headings: its outline is in classes and identifiers of its own. Headings are read by their shape, a keyword and a number in a paragraph of their own with the title in the paragraph after it, and nested by how often each keyword occurs. An annex sits beside the chapters, not inside the last of them.
